categories.description: When you know something needs to be said, but starting feels overwhelming.

phrases.text: I’m having a hard time finding the right words, but I want to be honest about where I am today.
phrases.context: Useful when you want to open up without feeling pressured to tell the story perfectly.

phrases.text: There’s something weighing on me that I’d like to share, but I don’t need advice or answers right now.
phrases.context: Helps set clear expectations before speaking.

phrases.text: Do you have 10 quiet minutes? I don’t need you to fix anything, just to sit with me for a moment.
phrases.context: A gentle invitation for someone’s calm attention.

categories.situation: Expressing overwhelm without a tidy conclusion
categories.description: When things feel disorganized or heavy inside and you can’t summarize it neatly.

phrases.text: Everything feels loud and slightly too much right now, and I’m having trouble sorting through it.
phrases.context: Validates feelings of cognitive or sensory exhaustion.

phrases.text: I’m not in immediate danger, but I feel empty and tired in a way sleep doesn’t seem to fix.
phrases.context: Clarifies emotional exhaustion while distinguishing it from an acute crisis.

phrases.text: I don’t fully understand why today feels so heavy, but pretending it doesn't is taking all my energy.
phrases.context: Relieves the burden of needing an intellectual explanation for low mood.

categories.situation: Asking for quiet presence instead of solutions
categories.description: When you need companionable silence or gentle listening rather than problem-solving.

phrases.text: Could we just take a short walk or sit together without talking about solutions for a bit?
phrases.context: Grounds the connection in physical calm without demand for performance.

phrases.text: If I get quiet or teary, it’s not because you did anything wrong; I just need space to breathe.
phrases.context: Reassures the other person so you can both relax into the moment.

categories.situation: Setting a gentle boundary when depleted
categories.description: When you need to pause or step back without feeling cold or guilty.

phrases.text: I care about this conversation, but my cup is completely empty right now. Can we pick this up tomorrow?
phrases.context: Protects your remaining reserves while honoring the relationship.

phrases.text: I don’t have the emotional capacity to listen well right now, but I want to make time once I’ve recharged.
phrases.context: Honest self-awareness that prevents resentment or burnout.
